name: Shafran's Hexagonal Chess
author: Isaak Grigorevich Shafran (1939) / AGP port
description: The Soviet hexagonal chess: Isaak Shafran's 1939 game (registered 1956, shown at the 1960 Leipzig Olympiad) on an irregular 70-cell hexagon — far closer to chess's 64 squares than Gliński's 91. Nine files, ten obliquely descending ranks, three bishops on the three colours, bishop-wise pawn captures, a first pawn move that reaches the middle of its own file (three cells on the centre files) with en passant on every cell crossed, and — uniquely among the classical hex chesses — castling, long or short, toward either rook.
